caption: The drawing features a central large heart-shaped area containing German text written in black ink, bordered by a scalloped green and brown outline. Around the central heart, there are five smaller heart shapes – two at the top corners, two at the bottom corners, and one at the lower left, each with German text bordered by a red scalloped outline. The area outside the central heart is decorated with stylized floral motifs, including large red, orange, and green flowers with visible stems and leaves extending toward the edges of the page. Each side of the central heart features a bird; both birds have brown wings, red heads, brown tails, orange beaks, and are perched on green branches with leaves and flowers. At the bottom right, there are two hand-drawn initials in green. The drawing is rendered primarily in shades of red, brown, green, black, and orange, with the paper being a creamy beige. There is a subtle background staining or foxing that adds an aged look. The whole composition is symmetrically arranged, focusing attention on the central heart and surrounded by botanical and avian motifs.
title: Pa. German Birth Certificate (Waltman #3)
